description: Ordered severity of a code change finding (Leash-style review routing): how bad is this if merged.

instructions.question: How severe is the problem this code change introduces if it is merged as is?

levels.none: No problem introduced (docs, harmless comments, fixes).
levels.minor: Style, naming, logging or test hygiene; no effect on users or data.
levels.major: Incorrect behavior, data inconsistency, resource leak, information disclosure, or a group of users loses a function.
levels.critical: Authentication bypass, injection, secret exposure, or irreversible data loss.
